description: Get a second and third opinion on every message before one agent changes your files. Each preset you build becomes a model in the model picker: up to six advisor models answer in parallel, then an aggregator model reads their notes and does the work. A live panel in the thread shows what each advisor is doing and its answer as it streams. Type /moa in any other thread to put a question to the same advisors, or have the aggregator check in with them every few tool calls. Uses the providers you already installed and signed in to; each advisor adds a model turn to every message, and what an advisor reads goes to its model's provider.
